{#- CR-004 — ONE FORMAT PER DOCTYPE. This record is a ROUTER, not a layout.

    The three axes the client asked to become tick options are each handled by
    something that already exists, which is why this is four lines and not a
    rewrite of a print stack that took two client-visible regressions to settle:

      Arabic     the print dialog's Language selector -> `yht_print_lang()`,
                 read inside the shared template
      Letterhead the print dialog's Letter Head selector, or the
                 `Print Without LH` button; every template already branches on
                 `letter_head` / `no_letterhead`
      Heading    `Print As` / `select_print_heading` -> `yht_print_heading()`

    🔴 ONLY THE PROFORMA IS A DIFFERENT LAYOUT. Measured: `proforma_invoice.html`
    shares 59% of its text with `quotation.html` and the difference is real —
    a per-line VAT split (`yht_row_taxes`), bilingual labels, and a meta block
    carrying Order Number, Currency, Sales Executive, Delivery Date and PO#.
    That is a document, not a heading, so it is routed to rather than merged;
    each template stays untouched and therefore renders byte-for-byte what its
    old dedicated format rendered. -#}
{%- set katc_show_bank = true -%}
{%- set katc_kind = (doc.get("custom_print_as") or doc.get("select_print_heading") or "") -%}
{% if katc_kind == "Proforma Invoice" %}{% include "yht_custom/templates/includes/katc/proforma_invoice.html" %}{% else %}{% include "yht_custom/templates/includes/katc/sales_order.html" %}{% endif %}
